text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection
I1, which must be performed every 
six months as indicated 
by M6 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
 rubber gloves, ... etc.
Personal safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety boots, safety goggles, rubber gloves, rubber 
 apron ... etc
Tool set.
Work to be Carried Out
Repeat Steps of Monthly Inspection Check List Doc. No.
 CP-002-r0
To change oil, remove screw plug with oil strainer attached,
 let the oil drain off in to a container, clean out strainer with solvent,
 re-insert strainer and screw plug
Fill compressor with new approved oil, approximately 10
 liters of new oil is required
After the oil change operation is completed the compressor
 must be started several times in succession since the suction line to the
 oil pump was emptied during the oil change operation
Check air filter cartridge, if it is dirty, blow the
 cartridge out with compressed air from the inside outwards, if paper
 elements in cartridge are damaged, install a new filter cartridge
Ensure that filter cartridge is properly seated when filter
 housing is re-assembled
Check oil level in compressor crank case, but only with the
 compressor at rest, the oil level should never fall below the sight-glass
Check for any unusual noises or vibrations
Check for air leaks in piping and pipe connections
Read and record gauge pressures and compressor running time
 indicator
Clean compressor room floor
